name: NetBird
short_description: WireGuard-based mesh VPN that connects all your devices into a private network.
description: NetBird is a zero-config WireGuard mesh VPN that connects your servers, devices, and containers into a secure private network. Unlike traditional VPNs, every node communicates directly (peer-to-peer) using WireGuard tunnels with NAT traversal, requiring no open ports or central traffic relay. Managed via the NetBird cloud dashboard or a self-hosted management server. Ideal for securely accessing home servers from anywhere without exposing them to the internet.
usecases: Securely access your home server from anywhere without opening firewall ports.
Connect all your devices (laptops, phones, servers) into one private network.
Replace a traditional VPN with a peer-to-peer WireGuard mesh.
Enforce zero-trust network access policies across your infrastructure.
notes: NB_SETUP_KEY must be obtained from your NetBird dashboard at app.netbird.io — generate one under Setup Keys.
Uses host network mode and NET_ADMIN capabilities to manage WireGuard interfaces.
The management server defaults to NetBird cloud — self-host the server for full independence.
No ports are exposed — NetBird operates via outbound WireGuard tunnels only.
